props.name: animation
props.description:
Indicator motion while the value is indeterminate: `carousel` slides the bar along the track,
`reverse` slides it in the opposite direction, `swing` moves it back and forth, and `elastic`
slides it while it grows to full length mid-track. Determinate progress does not animate.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description:
`Intl.NumberFormat` options for the displayed value and `aria-valuetext`, using the provider
locale. Like `Slider` and `BoldSlider`, they format the raw clamped `value`, not the completed
fraction; a `percent` style multiplies by 100, so pair it with a `max` of `1`. Without
`formatOptions` the text is the completed percentage rounded to 2 decimal places (`'40%'`).
A `valueLabel` function takes precedence.

props.name: label
props.description:
Content for the label slot. Also used as the default `aria-label` when it is a string; an
explicit `aria-label` takes precedence.

props.name: max
props.description: The value that counts as complete. A negative or non-finite number falls back to `100`.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: translations
props.description: Localized message overrides for this progress instance, such as the `aria-valuetext` announced while indeterminate.

props.name: value
props.description:
The current value, from `0` to `max`; values outside that range are clamped. Leave it `undefined`
(or non-finite) for indeterminate progress, which sets no `aria-valuenow`.

props.name: valueLabel
props.type: boolean | ((props: { percent: number; value: number; max: number }) => string)
props.description:
Whether to show the value slot for determinate progress, or a formatter for it.
The formatter receives the clamped `value`, `max` and `percent` (`0`-`100`, rounded to 2 decimals)
and returns the text; the result also supplies `aria-valuetext`. Nothing is shown while indeterminate.
